name: Iridescent Material with Perturbation
aliases: Iridescent Material with Specular and Shadow
definition: An iridescent shading model using a cosine palette function (`pal`) driven by a perturbed normal, combined with specular highlights and shadowing.
summary: Iridescent Material with Perturbation simulates thin-film colors by modulating a cosine palette with a position-perturbed normal, offering a cheap artistic alternative to physical thin-film models.
